title: Anthropic Delivers Fantastic News for AI Stock Investors | NVDA, MRVL, INTC, AMD, AMZN, AVGO, GOOG
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA reacts to Anthropic's reported third-quarter revenue of $16.8 billion, up roughly 50% quarter on quarter from about $11.5 billion in Q2, implying a run rate near $67 billion, and discusses an expected IPO valuation around $2 trillion, possibly around November, which he frames as reasonable in comparison with SpaceX. His central argument is ecosystem-wide rather than stock-specific: Anthropic's growth is good news for the AI and semiconductor supply chain that provides its compute. The tickers discussed in that context are Nvidia, AMD, Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Oracle, TSMC, ASML, Broadcom and Marvell, alongside Intel in the title — all logged as UNCERTAIN passing mentions, with no explicit buy, hold or sell call, no stated price and no fair-value estimate for any of them. The caveat he returns to is demand quality: he wants to see proven end-customer use cases delivering a positive return on investment, rather than spending justified only by the build-out itself. He attributes recent semiconductor weakness to interest-rate and government-debt fears rather than to a break in the AI story. The video was first seen as members-only and later became public, which is why it was analyzed in the 15:00 run.
